isFast.title: Fast Sync
isFast.description: Only sync recent items to save time and API calls

apiUrl.title: Cloudflare Worker API URL
apiUrl.description: The URL of the Cloudflare Worker to ingest data (e.g. https://my-worker.workers.dev)

cookieString.title: Zhihu Cookie String
cookieString.description: Your full Zhihu cookie string (including z_c0)

apiSecret.title: Ingest API Secret
apiSecret.description: Bearer token for the Cloudflare Worker /ingest endpoints. Must match API_SECRET in the Worker. Leave empty only for local testing.

upvotesCursor.title: Upvotes Resume Cursor
upvotesCursor.description: Internal: moments paging.next cursor from the last interrupted run. Injected automatically by the Worker; do not set manually.

fullModeUsers.title: Full Mode Followed Users
fullModeUsers.description: URL tokens of followed users configured for full backup
